global: This shio ramen features a clear, light broth with neatly arranged toppings: chashu, halved soft-boiled egg, nori, and menma. Served in a white bowl with a salt emblem, it rests on a wooden table under bright, even lighting.

regions.background: Light brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and smooth surface texture.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with glossy finish, subtle black logo near rim, smooth curved surface.
regions.soup: Clear golden broth with thin noodles, garnished with bean sprouts, sesame seeds, and green onions, floating gently in the liquid.
regions.cut_egg: A halved boiled egg reveals a vibrant orange yolk, firm white, and a small translucent shrimp-like piece nestled within.
regions.seaweed: Dark green nori seaweed, irregularly shaped, with textured surface and visible veins, appears slightly curled and fragmented.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows browned, tender texture with visible fat marbling and thin white garnish strands on its surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, sliced into thick, irregular pieces with a slightly fibrous, matte texture.
